title: Google DeepMind 论文：自我改进的 Agent 边学边忘，学新任务
html:
Google DeepMind 论文：自我改进的 Agent 边学边忘，学新任务

New Google DeepMind paper finds that self-improving agents forget as they learn, and the method that learned new tasks fastest broke old ones the most.

Self-evolving agents improve without retraining by editing their system prompt, memory, or skill files. In real use tasks keep shifting, and each edit made for 1 task also applies to every task that follows.

The team ran ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness on task streams that changed topic, workflow, or domain. They tracked how much each method learned on the current task and lost on the others.

GEPA learned the most, 6.2 points per block on average, and also lost the most elsewhere, 4.3 points. After it learned to ask users for missing details, a later block rewrote that rule and its 15.5-point gain fell to 2.5.

If your agent edits its own prompt or memory, keep task-specific rules separate and retest old tasks after every update.

# Google DeepMind 论文：自我改进的 Agent 边学边忘，学新任务

New Google DeepMind paper finds that self-improving agents forget as they learn, and the method that learned new tasks fastest broke old ones the most.

Self-evolving agents improve without retraining by editing their system prompt, memory, or skill files. In real use tasks keep shifting, and each edit made for 1 task also applies to every task that follows.

The team ran ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness on task streams that changed topic, workflow, or domain. They tracked how much each method learned on the current task and lost on the others.

GEPA learned the most, 6.2 points per block on average, and also lost the most elsewhere, 4.3 points. After it learned to ask users for missing details, a later block rewrote that rule and its 15.5-point gain fell to 2.5.

If your agent edits its own prompt or memory, keep task-specific rules separate and retest old tasks after every update.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 论文研究自我进化 Agent（通过修改系统提示、记忆或技能文件而非重训来改进）在任务不断变化时的遗忘问题。团队让 ReasoningBank、GEPA 和 Meta-Harness 在话题、工作流或领域变化的任务流上运行，同时衡量当前任务的学习和其他任务的损失。GEPA 学得最多（平均每块 6.2 分），但在其他任务上损失也最大（4.3 分）；例如它学会询问用户缺失信息后，后续一次改写把 15.5 分的增益降到 2.5 分。作者建议：如果 Agent 会修改自己的提示或记忆，应把任务专属规则分开存放，并在每次更新后回测旧任务。
html_zh:
Google DeepMind 论文：自我改进的 Agent 边学边忘，学新任务

新的 Google DeepMind 论文发现，自我改进的智能体在学习时会忘记，而最快学习新任务的方法对旧任务的破坏最大。

通过编辑系统提示、内存或技能文件，自我进化代理无需重新训练即可改进。在实际使用中，任务不断变化，对 1 个任务所做的每次编辑也适用于后续的每个任务。

该团队在更改主题、工作流程或领域的任务流上运行 ReasoningBank、GEPA 和 Meta-Harness。他们跟踪了每种方法在当前任务中学到了多少，以及在其他方法中损失了多少。

GEPA 学到的最多，平均每块 6.2 分，其他地方也损失最多，4.3 分。在它学会询问用户缺失的细节后，后来的一个区块重写了该规则，其 15.5 点的增益跌至 2.5 点。

如果您的代理编辑自己的提示或内存，请将特定于任务的规则分开，并在每次更新后重新测试旧任务。
